meta.name: Classical · shifted · distance-relative width
meta.regime: Shifted Gaussian samples with width above dist(t,L)/f(n)
meta.rules: For efficiently computable superpolynomial f, require s > dist(t,L)/f(n). The coefficient 1 is only normalized when log n log f(n)=o(n). Output count is mass dependent, not a fixed 2^{n/2} batch. This is not all-width shifted DGS.
